title: FSANZ energy statement for packaged alcoholic beverages

versions.notes: Initial rules, transcribed from Build Brief 01 sections 2, 7 and 8. The primary sources were NOT re-read: www.foodstandards.gov.au, www.wineaustralia.com and www.legislation.gov.au were blocked by the network policy of the session-1 build environment, so every regulatory verified_at is null. The two studio rules sourced only from the brief (min_rule_weight_pt, servings_decimal_places) are verified against Build Brief 01. Search-engine excerpts retrieved on 2026-09-27 are consistent with the compliance date, the 0.5% ABV threshold, the bordered tabular format and the averages requirement, but they are not a substitute for reading the sources.

compliance_date.notes: Three-year transition. Products packaged and labelled on or after this date must carry the statement.

min_abv_percent.notes: Inclusive: beverages containing no less than 0.5% alcohol by volume are covered.

value.description: The beverage already displays a nutrition information panel.
The package has a surface area of less than 100 cm².
The food is not required to bear a label.

title_text.notes: Heading of the prescribed format, in capitals.

table_with_borders.notes: The prescribed format is tabular, with borders.

labels.notes: Mandatory contents: servings per package; serving size in mL; standard drinks per serving; average energy per serving and per 100 mL. {package} is replaced by the package word. Check the exact wording against the prescribed format when verifying.

column_headings.notes: The statement must indicate that quantities are averages, for example in the column headings. Wording from Build Brief 01 section 7.

energy_units.notes: Energy per serving and per 100 mL in kJ, optionally also in Cal.

max_significant_figures.notes: A ceiling: energy values are shown to no more than three significant figures.

standard_drinks_decimal_places.notes: Standard drinks per serving are shown to one decimal place.

package_word.notes: FSANZ guidance Note 1: "package" may be replaced by "can", "bottle" or another accurate word. Cask and keg come from the Build Brief 01 scope.

value: total standard drinks in the package
existing_duties.notes: FSANZ guidance Note 2: these must still appear elsewhere on the label. Shown to the user as a reminder, never inside the panel.

standard_drink_ethanol_g.notes: One standard drink is 10 g of ethanol (Build Brief 01 section 7). Confirm against the Code's definition of standard drink when verifying.

ethanol_density_g_per_ml.notes: Build Brief 01 section 7. Confirm against the Code when verifying.

kj_per_cal.notes: Cal = kJ / 4.184 (Build Brief 01 section 7). Confirm against the Code's conversion factor when verifying.

servings_decimal_places.notes: Servings per package are shown to one decimal place when not a whole number (Build Brief 01 section 7).

min_rule_weight_pt.notes: Studio print-production rule (Build Brief 01 section 7): table cell borders and outer border at no less than 0.25 pt at the exported size.

min_type_size.notes: Build Brief 01 section 8 asks the developer to verify from the Code whether a minimum type size applies. null means no minimum is enforced. When verified, set {"size_mm": n, "measure": "cap_height" | "x_height"} to match how the Code measures size of type; exports below it are then blocked.
